logline: Seeking shelter from the cold rain, Juliana arrives at her new husband's modest woodland cottage and discovers an unexpected sense of peace beside the hearth.
continuity_notes: Picks up immediately from Episode 5, as Juliana and her mysterious new husband leave the Ashcroft estate behind and venture out into the rainy countryside.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium full tracking shot of Juliana and the Mysterious Bearded Man trudging along a muddy, rain-soaked path in the dark woods.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana lifts the hem of her white satin wedding gown to keep it out of the pooling mud, shivering under her dark hooded cloak.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Juliana's wet hand clutching her muddy dress.

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: Heavy rain pouring through dense tree canopies with steady footfalls on wet earth.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Upward shot through the dripping, silhouetted branches into the stormy night sky.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium two-shot framing Juliana and the Mysterious Bearded Man as they pause in the misty woods.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana turns back toward him, water glistening on her face and hair.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on the Mysterious Bearded Man, his dark hair soaked and rain running down the scars on his cheek.

events.label: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Solemn, Gentle)
events.content: "I know this is not the life you came from."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Juliana looking up into the rain, exhaling a soft breath of resignation.

events.label: JULIANA (Quiet, Melancholic)
events.content: "No."

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana looks upward into the canopy, gathering herself with a faint nod.

events.label: JULIANA (Resigned, Soft)
events.content: "It isn't."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man, gazing down at her with quiet remorse.

events.label: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Guilt-ridden)
events.content: "You should not have had to walk through this rain tonight."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Juliana's bodice and mother's pendant as she gathers her cloak closer.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana's face, offering a wistful, comforting smile.

events.label: JULIANA (Faintly Ironic, Resilient)
events.content: "I suppose the day was already ruined."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Extreme close-up on the Mysterious Bearded Man's piercing eyes, touched by her lack of bitterness.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Wide establishing shot through tree branches showing a secluded, rustic stone cottage nestled among the misty trees.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: They walk forward toward the cottage emerging from the dark woods.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up on Juliana's face, wide-eyed with realization.

events.label: JULIANA (Surprised, Hesitant)
events.content: "That is it?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up on the Mysterious Bearded Man.

events.label: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Low)
events.content: "Yes."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Upward shot of rain pelting through the thick treetops.

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: Sudden distant rumble of thunder echoing across the forest.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot as Juliana hikes her skirt and begins walking briskly toward the cottage door.

events.label: JULIANA (Determined, Defiant)
events.content: "At least no one there will be waiting to humiliate me."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man watching her march ahead, his expression solemn and deeply reflective.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: The heavy wooden cottage door creaks open. Juliana steps across the threshold into the dark, barren room.

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: Door hinges groaning open followed by the hollow thump of footsteps on wet wood floorboards.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up overhead shot of a wooden bucket catching raindrops dripping steadily from a leak in the ceiling.

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: Rhythmic water drips plinking into the metal-rimmed wooden bucket.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium wide shot past the drip bucket as the Mysterious Bearded Man closes the door behind them.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man standing in the dim light by the door.

events.label: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Humble, Apologetic)
events.content: "I am sorry."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Juliana gazing around the rustic interior, taking in the sparse surroundings.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man looking at her with somber honesty.

events.label: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Grave, Sincere)
events.content: "You came from comfort."

events.label: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Grave, Sincere)
events.content: "This is all I can give you now."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Juliana undoing the ribbon tie of her black cloak and letting it slide off her shoulders.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana removes her dark cloak, revealing her damp white bridal dress underneath.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana's hand pressing against the cold, condensation-fogged windowpane.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Side profile shot of Juliana looking out the rain-streaked window into the quiet forest.

events.label: JULIANA (Gentle, Peaceful)
events.content: "It is quiet."

events.label: JULIANA (Gentle, Peaceful)
events.content: "Very quiet."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind Juliana looking at the Mysterious Bearded Man watching her attentively.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Juliana turning back toward him, a soft, genuine smile illuminating her face.

events.label: JULIANA (Earnest, Content)
events.content: "I think I like that."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man, slightly surprised by her reaction.

events.label: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Incredulous)
events.content: "You are not disappointed?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Juliana meeting his gaze honestly.

events.label: JULIANA (Direct, Soft)
events.content: "I am."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Over-the-shoulder shot behind Juliana as the Mysterious Bearded Man listens intently.

events.label: JULIANA (Warm, Reassuring)
events.content: "But not because of you."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot as Juliana grabs a rag from the rustic wooden table and begins briskly scrubbing the damp surface.

events.label: JULIANA (Determined, Practical)
events.content: "If this is our home, I want it clean."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man stepping forward to intervene gently.

events.label: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Caring, Tender)
events.content: "You don't have to do that tonight."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Juliana's hands vigorously scrubbing grime from the wooden tabletop.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana's face, her voice catching with raw, suppressed emotion as she scrubs.

events.label: JULIANA (Vulnerable, Trembling)
events.content: "If I stop now, I will think about everything I lost."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Full shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man standing motionless, his gaze filled with empathy and understanding.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Instead of stopping her, the Mysterious Bearded Man kneels beside the table and begins inspecting and adjusting the wobbly table leg to help.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium low shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man kneeling beside Juliana as she wipes the table.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana picks up a straw broom and sweeps the stone floor in front of the stone hearth.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Wide shot of Juliana sweeping dust toward the large stone fireplace.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: The Mysterious Bearded Man carries a heavy wooden log across the room and places it onto the iron grate in the hearth.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tracking shot following the Mysterious Bearded Man as he sets the firewood into the stone fireplace.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: He strikes flint and steel together over dry kindling, igniting bright sparks that catch into a flickering flame.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Extreme close-up on hands striking flint, sparks showering onto the twigs and catching fire.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of vibrant orange flames rapidly spreading across the dry logs, crackling warmly.

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: Crisp crackling and snapping of dry wood catching fire in the hearth.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Juliana standing by the table, broom resting against her hip, bathed in the amber firelight.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: The Mysterious Bearded Man stands up from the hearth, dusting his hands on his coat.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man rising before the blazing fireplace.

events.label: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Relieved)
events.content: "There."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana looking at him with radiant gratitude and a gentle smile.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man gesturing faintly to the modest room.

events.label: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Quiet, Modest)
events.content: "It is not much."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Juliana kneeling on the stone floor before the blazing hearth, wrapping her dark cloak around her shoulders.

events.label: JULIANA (Soft, Comforted)
events.content: "It is enough for tonight."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Wide shot framing the roaring hearth fire between them as the Mysterious Bearded Man crouches down beside her on the stone floor.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana pulling her cloak tighter, her face glowing warmly in the firelight.

events.label: JULIANA (V.O.) (Reflective, Vulnerable)
events.content: "I lost my home today."

events.label: JULIANA (V.O.) (Reflective, Vulnerable)
events.content: "My family."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the glowing embers and dancing flames inside the fireplace.

events.label: JULIANA (V.O.) (Reflective, Vulnerable)
events.content: "Everything I thought my life would be."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on the Mysterious Bearded Man's scarred, work-worn hands resting quietly on his knees.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Juliana looking down into the flames, a peaceful serenity washing over her features.

events.label: JULIANA (V.O.) (Gentle, Surprised)
events.content: "And yet..."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Extreme close-up on the Mysterious Bearded Man's profile, his scarred cheek illuminated by the amber glow as he watches over her protectively.

events.label: JULIANA (V.O.) (Tender, Safe)
events.content: "Sitting here with him, I don't feel afraid."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Juliana looking up into the room with quiet hope in her blue eyes.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on the crackling flames and glowing embers of the fireplace, slowly fading to black as the music swells warmly.

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: Warm hearth crackles blending with gentle string music fading out.

analysis_metadata.note: No invented LLM scene metadata; event-level evidence drives promo selection.
